svg.aria-label: Illustrative. One host at 127.0.0.1:8080/apps/<name>/ holds a field of small app cells, almost all asleep; dashed cells are static sites with no process. An agent publishes a directory (pneuma-space.json and src/server.ts) as an upload with no image build (the isolate scaffold is live 6.9 s after publish), and a new cell, board, appears asleep until visited. A visitor request passes the gateway stages ingress, identity, static and wake, and wakes board for the first time (460 to 700 ms); its db, kv and object edges light to the shared services (Redis, an S3 store, SQLite or PostgreSQL behind db()) and a WebSocket stays open through the gateway. Object bytes go from the browser straight to the bucket with a presigned PUT, past the app and the gateway, while board goes idle and sleeps with its data kept. It wakes again in 62 to 87 ms; a container app, pulse-go, wakes in about 260 ms; a static site, docs, is answered by the gateway with nothing woken. Then spin hangs in a busy loop that holds its worker; it is stopped 3.5 to 4 s after the stuck request and the Guard quarantines it, while its neighbours survey and ttt keep answering. A new release of spin replaces it with its data kept. The field is calm again: nearly all asleep, every address valid, all data kept.
svg.title: PneumaSpace: one host, many sleeping apps

g.text: presigned PUT · bytes skip app and gateway
calm · nearly all asleep · every address valid · all data kept
